resolvedDuringVerification: Initial bundled Rust TLS backend compile failed; Windows native-tls selected and real builds passed.
Initial Prisma Roaming cache permission failure resolved with a workspace schema-engine helper.
A PostgreSQL test-hook connection timeout was diagnosed and later full runs passed with bounded connection timeouts.
Recovery operator audit identity violated its FK; disabled system principal/database-role audit fixed and the real stopped-service tool passed.
A WebView IPC-interception assertion did not attach to the cached binding; it was replaced with actual shared native-boundary response-field assertions and the normal WebView flow passed.
Device lock-upgrade and tenant/membership order identified in audit; exclusive recovery lock and common tenant-owner order applied; six-request recovery race passed.
limitations: Synthetic Windows debug UI/resource samples only, no low-end/release-scale SLA or human screen-reader trial.
16 MiB book/request, 17 MiB encoded IPC, 18 MiB native response and 128 MiB local backup limits; full as-of snapshots and retention need Phase 9 scale review.
SQLite plaintext and one local vault owner; Windows account/disk protection required.
Offline revocation/clock/OS-administrator trust cannot be guaranteed; grants last at most 24 hours.
Non-Windows lockfile advisories retained; Linux not supported/verified.
Public hosting/TLS deployment, production key rotation, encrypted PostgreSQL backup/PITR/RPO/RTO drills and signed installation remain later approval gates.
Missing accepted server history stops recovery for operator/accountant reconstruction; no automatic financial repair or key-loss bypass.
Cross-device editing of another source draft is not supplied; browser offline support remains Phase 5.
